name: transcribe_audio
description: Transcribe an audio file using Whisper. Supports various audio formats (wav, mp3, m4a, etc.). Returns the transcribed text.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the audio file to transcribe

model.description: Whisper model to use (tiny.en, base.en, small.en, medium.en, large). Default: base.en

language.description: Language code (e.g., en, es, fr). Default: en

output_format.description: Output format: text (plain text), timestamps (with timestamps), json (structured). Default: text
